verdicts.reason: Both banners have the same layout: a tiny product at far left, a headline that crowds the CTA, and subcopy around 6px that can't be read at 320x50. A drops the Q logo badge entirely, so the brand is lost. B keeps the logo, but it is a speck of about 10px wedged between the headline and the subcopy, cramped and illegible, though at least the brand mark is still there.
